C0601.title: Supreme People's Court Typical Case: Wang and Others Used Virtual Currency to Transfer Telecom Fraud Proceeds
C0601.summary: In July 2025, the Supreme People’s Court released typical cases on punishing crimes related to assistance for information network crimes, including a case in which Wang and others transferred telecom-fraud proceeds through virtual-currency transactions. The public material states that the defendants used bank cards to receive and move criminal funds and then bought virtual currency to transfer proceeds upstream, leading to criminal liability for concealing or disguising criminal proceeds and related conduct. This model links bank-card collection, offline cash withdrawal, and on-chain virtual-asset transfer, increasing tracing difficulty and showing the need for stronger abnormal-funds monitoring across payment accounts, bank cards, and virtual-asset exchanges.
